## Blank register

| ID | Action | Owner | Due | Dependency | Status | Evidence of done |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| A-001 | [verb + object] | [one owner] | [date] | [ID or none] | queued / active / blocked / done / cancelled | [observable result] |

## Completed example

| ID | Action | Owner | Due | Dependency | Status | Evidence of done |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| A-031 | Book privacy consultation | student | Friday | none | active | calendar confirmation saved |

## Decision rules

“Sent” is not “done” when the action requires approval, access or a response. Use **blocked** and name the dependency. Do not assign actions to “we”.

## Scenario test

A request was emailed but access has not arrived. The action remains blocked, preventing false completion.
